searchText: Yes, it is! There is a deprecation notice in the Cancun spec (https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/420), and i am to prepare procedural document and present it on the ACDE call this week. Though, the procedure is slightly different to what is in the comment. I think that it is easier for EL to remove error message from logs in this method hasn't been called than for CL to deal with Method not found error which likely to have a generic handler; though, this is debatable I'd agree with removing the error messages from the EL logs, on top of whatever else it might do. probably require not logging, then CLs can just stop sending it, and those which do are unaffected Out now: https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/releases/tag/v0.1.0-alpha.1. No more shilling^^ <dankrad> Is the focus mainly being a better archive node or will you also be targeting non-archive performance? i believe the next big 'feature' for reth will be "full node" style sync i think the full vision is to be a modular stack of node parts so you can easy configure any type of node you want

excerpts.author: m.kalinin
excerpts.content:
Yes, it is! There is a deprecation notice in the Cancun spec (https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/420), and i am to prepare procedural document and present it on the ACDE call this week.

Though, the procedure is slightly different to what is in the comment. I think that it is easier for EL to remove error message from logs in this method hasn't been called than for CL to deal with Method not found error which likely to have a generic handler; though, this is debatable

excerpts.author: tersec
excerpts.content: I'd agree with removing the error messages from the EL logs, on top of whatever else it might do. probably require not logging, then CLs can just stop sending it, and those which do are unaffected
